questions.question_english: 53. What is the primary objective of the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) managed by the Sports Authority of India?
options_english: Funding the development and construction of modern sports stadiums in rural villages
Organizing comprehensive national annual inter-university sports championships
Financially supporting and training elite prospects for Olympic success
Distributing monthly retirement pensions and healthcare benefits to former sportspersons
questions.explanation_english: The Target Olympic Podium Scheme was instituted by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports within the National Sports Development Fund framework. Its core objective is to identify, support, and train elite sports prospects capable of winning medals at the Olympic and Paralympic Games. Selected athletes receive customized training from premier coaches, international competition exposure, and a monthly pocket allowance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। टारगेट ओलंपिक पोडियम योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य ओलंपिक और पैरालंपिक खेलों में पदक जीतने की क्षमता रखने वाले अभिजात खेल संभावनाओं की पहचान करना, उनका समर्थन करना और उन्हें प्रशिक्षण देना है। चयनित खिलाड़ियों को प्रमुख कोचों से अनुकूलित प्रशिक्षण, अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिताओं में भागीदारी, और मासिक भत्ता प्रदान किया जाता है।
